EC1: Central [OR] + mixed apneas [AND] > 25% of the total apnea-hypopnea index (AHI)
EC2: Any anatomical finding that would compromise the performance of upper airway stimulation, such as the presence of complete concentric collapse of the soft palate
EC3: Any condition or procedure that has compromised neurological control of the upper airway
EC4: Patients who are unable or do not have the necessary assistance to operate the patient remote
EC5: Patients who are pregnant or plan to become pregnant
EC6: Patients who will require magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
EC7: Patients with an implantable device that may be susceptible to unintended interaction with the Inspire system.
EC9: Any chronic medical illness or condition that contraindicates a surgi [AND]cal procedure under g [AND]eneral anesthesia, as judged by the clinical study Investigator
EC10: Has a terminal illness with life expectancy < 12 months
EC11: Active psychiatric disease (psychotic illness, major de [OR]pression, or acute [OR] anxiety attacks) which prevents subject compliance with the requirements of the investigational study testing
EC12: Any other reason the investigator deems subject is unfit for participation in the study
